answer_1.quote: Our MapNav agent uses the constructed ASM as input, harnessing the powerful end-to-end capabilities of VLM to enhance vision-and-language navigation.
answer_1.outputs: executable navigation actions in text format

answer_2.quote: We utilize several widely used evaluation metrics for VLN tasks: Navigation Error (NE), Oracle Success rate (OS), Success Rate (SR), Success weighted Path Length (SPL), and normalized Dynamic Temporal Wrapping (nDTW).
